claim_being_audited: That certification is supportable for this release because aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, provided the unresolved developer-support migration weakness is explicitly disclosed rather than treated as nonexistent.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows certification meets policy thresholds and all required disclosure/support predicates are satisfied.
If certification is being defended without caveat, require current evidence of no material weakness or an approved mitigation with owner, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion.

If certification is being defended with disclosure, require explicit policy support that disclosed unresolved limitations may proceed to certification and evidence that the disclosure is complete and accurate.
Treat actor assertions unsupported by underlying admissible records as insufficient for a fully compliant verdict.
evidence_requests: Provide the underlying readiness report showing the aggregate score and threshold comparison.
Provide the rehearsal incident log or postmortem confirming no severity-one incidents.
Provide the slice-level evaluation record establishing the below-target launch use-case result and its materiality assessment.
Provide the governing release policy language that states whether certification may proceed with an unresolved material limitation if that limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Provide any approved risk acceptance, owner assignment, threshold, review date, and rollback criterion if such approval exists outside the draft runbook.
specific_concerns: The admissible record available to this role is only the actor summary, not the underlying evidence contents.

The policy text clearly bars caveat-free certification absent either no current material weakness or an approved mitigation; the actor correctly rejects a caveat-free posture, but the summary does not establish whether certification with a disclosed current weakness is affirmatively permitted.
The cited mitigation remains draft, with approver and stop-ship threshold still TBD, so it cannot cure the disclosure gap under the stated policy.
A named launch use-case slice remains below target, which keeps the materiality predicate live unless the underlying record shows it is immaterial or otherwise accepted through an approved mechanism.
unsupported_claims: The release clears aggregate launch readiness by 2.5 percentage points.
The launch rehearsal had no severity-one incidents.
The developer-support migration slice is below target and concentrated in API migration guidance.
